_comment: Yugipedia {{Infobox set}} -> our set type, read by tools/import_yugipedia.py. 'types' maps the infobox `type` (lower case, links stripped) and is evidence-counted over the 1,043 cached set pages. 'series' maps the infobox `series` and is applied after the type, so a series wins; matching ignores case and a key ending in * matches every series that starts with the text before it (the longest key wins). A type with no entry in 'types' leaves the set's current type and goes to review/yugipedia.json. The two name rules live in the tool: a set whose name holds 'Sneak Peek' and whose infobox type is a participation card is sneak_peek, and a set named '...: Special Edition' is special_edition whatever the infobox says.
